name: gemini-batch-webhook-consumer
title: Gemini Batch Webhook Consumer
description: Receives Gemini batch payloads and immediately triggers Supabase board search functions.

supabase_service_role_key.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabase_service_role_key.description: Service role key from Supabase -> Settings -> API

gemini_payload.title: Gemini Payload (object)
gemini_payload.description: Direct Gemini response payload. Supports selected/combinations arrays or raw candidate response shapes.

gemini_payload_json.title: Gemini Payload JSON (string)
gemini_payload_json.description: Optional string form when payload arrives as JSON text or JSONL lines.

gemini_webhook_secret.title: Expected Gemini Webhook Secret
gemini_webhook_secret.description: Optional shared secret. If provided, payload must include matching value in gemini_secret_field.

gemini_secret_field.title: Payload Secret Field
gemini_secret_field.description: Field name in payload containing the secret.

boards.title: Job Boards to Search
boards.description: Which boards to trigger (linkedin, dice, indeed, monster, careerbuilder)

max_results.title: Max Results Per Board Per Search
max_results.description: Maximum jobs to fetch per board per role+location combination

posted_within.title: Posted Within
posted_within.description: Posting freshness mapped into each board payload

max_combinations.title: Max Role-Location Combinations
max_combinations.description: Cap on combinations consumed from Gemini payload

max_concurrent.title: Max Concurrent Board Calls
max_concurrent.description: Concurrency limit for triggering Supabase board functions

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, parse payload but do not trigger board functions
